environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with IMDSv1 enabled on the underlying host. The task IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ServiceMeshGateway) has s3:*, sts:AssumeRole, and ec2:Describe* permissions. No network ACLs restrict outbound traffic from the container. The service is exposed via an ALB with no WAF attached. The container runs with default networking allowing access to the link-local metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254.
